mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and depress S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2pp year-over-year, it signals a weakening supply-side economy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth slows by >2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts and retail sales decline month-over-month, it signals a weakening consumer demand environment that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Concurrent m-o-m declines in HOUST and RSAFS, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 4% and payroll employment growth accelerates month-over-month, it signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage growth and support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS m-o-m acceleration, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a potential inflationary regime that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y-o-y > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth accelerates by more than 1pp quarter-over-quarter and the federal funds rate is below 3%, it signals a strong demand environment supported by easy monetary policy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 q-o-q acceleration > 1pp and FEDFUNDS < 3%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.
